development_infrastructure.account_selection: local tooling pins CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID; Pages Git deployment owns its account context

migration_state.recovery: Use python scripts/cloudflare_development_access.py --auth-only (or --auth-mode oauth) before any future Development D1/R2 operation. Reapply database_platform_convergence.sql only when the read-only readiness/verification authority proves drift.

next_release_preparation.principle: prepare schema and interfaces without changing Development D1 until Release 447 live acceptance is closed or a proven Release 447 defect requires repair

workstreams.scope: New in-house-created products require real raw-inventory lineage and consumption authority before publication; existing products may remain legacy_pending; antiquity, resale and external finished goods can be explicitly inventory-exempt.
Record durable tools and molds used to create products separately from consumable inventory; tool association never consumes the durable tool.

Link materials/tools to manufacturer/vendor provenance and store Devil n Dove-authored purchased-item review content locally with external identifiers/source links; do not scrape or depend on copied marketplace review content.

I.T. owns social/provider integration configuration references, purpose, secret or binding name only, callback/webhook, scopes, environment, configured/tested status, last test/error and correction mechanics; never store secret values in D1.
Generalize Storefront carousel presentation for Movie use without duplicating carousel authority or introducing extra public H1 elements.
Repair provably incorrect Movie names and core metadata; represent unknown/incomplete fields explicitly instead of guessing.
Future D1 additions must reserve explicit pending, legacy_pending, exempt, unverified, verified and evidence-reference states so unconfirmed workflows never masquerade as proven.
